features.name: files_modified
features.description: Number of files modified in the observation window

features.name: files_created
features.description: Number of new files created in the observation window

features.name: files_deleted
features.description: Number of original files deleted in the observation window

features.name: mutations_per_second
features.description: Velocity of filesystem mutation events per second

features.name: average_entropy
features.description: Average Shannon entropy across all inspected files (0.0 to 8.0)

features.name: maximum_entropy
features.description: Maximum Shannon entropy observed in the window

features.name: entropy_delta
features.description: Shift in entropy relative to baseline (4.2 typical baseline)

features.name: high_entropy_file_ratio
features.description: Proportion of modified files exhibiting entropy >= 7.2

features.name: suspicious_extension_count
features.description: Count of files bearing known ransomware or suspicious extensions

features.name: extension_change_count
features.description: Number of files whose extension was altered during mutation

features.name: total_bytes_modified
features.description: Total payload size in bytes modified or written in window

features.name: average_file_size
features.description: Mean size in bytes of affected files

features.name: process_cpu
features.description: CPU utilization percentage of suspicious process

features.name: process_memory
features.description: Memory footprint in megabytes of suspicious process

features.name: number_of_active_processes
features.description: Total number of live concurrent system processes

features.name: burst_duration
features.description: Elapsed duration in seconds of the mutation burst
